Quote_Text:
I used to stay at Double Tree by Hilton Moda in Kadikoy before during my business trips and this time I chose this hotel based on my previous experience, but, unfortunately, I have to admit that the level of service at the hotel has dropped significantly. The bottles with shampoo and conditioner were empty, I had to constantly remind to replace them, cleaning was not perfect, only the staff at breakfast were pleasant. We booked a New Year's Eve dinner on the rooftop restaurant that was advertised there, but were very disappointed. 
When we arrived at the restaurant on 12th floor, me and my child were seated at a table right next to the stage, at the exit, although when the event manager showed the restaurant the day before, she assured that all the tables would be positioned so that we have a view of the Bosphorus. We didn’t get anything like that, we sat right at the exit, next to the DJ stand. I paid the full price of the dinner for three of us, incl the price for the child without any discounts, and did not receive what was promised. At the end of the evening, a fire broke out on the table from a candle and tinsel nearby and started to quickly spread across the table. The waiters put out the fire with almost their bare hands. My child was scared and cried, thank God he was not hurt. My accessories were damaged, but I didn’t pay much attention to it then, more worried about fire safety. I started looking around and saw no fire extinguishers. The staff simply put a new tablecloth and set the table. Well, I received no apology or interest in smoothing out the experience from the hotel staff either that evening or after. New Year's Eve was ruined, my child and I went to our room. From now on, I will avoid these hotels on my trips, and especially this hotel.

The “Lagazetta” Restaurant, which also offers room service, was a bit hard to reach by phone. Each time I called, my first attempt went unanswered, and they picked up on my second or third try. On my first day, I assumed that it might just be a rush hours for them. But the same thing happened on the following days at different hours. So if you think you might get hungry, it’s a good idea to plan ahead and allow at least half an hour just to place your order.
I also felt a little uncomfortable seeing such a strong security presence at the entrance, and the staff didn’t always come across as warm or welcoming. While I appreciate the importance of safety, the approach at times felt more like entering a military base or that kind of restricted area than arriving at a hotel. With the help of modern technology and a few guest friendly adjustments, I’m sure the hotel could maintain its high security standards while creating a more relaxed and inviting atmosphere.
